objective_breakdown: 5 hard constraints, all from task text: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (stage2, calc-energy contract caliber, electrolyte excluded); 4C fast charge without plating (stage3, anode_potential_v<0 -> plated=true); SEI<=500nm after 100x1C and <=550nm after 500x1C (stage2, aging output sei_thickness_nm_end); -20C discharge capacity retention>=0.90 (stage2, lowT capacity / 25C 1C capacity, mechanically derived). Trade-off expectation: ED (thick electrodes/thin collectors/thin separator/low porosity) conflicts with 4C plating margin and low-T transport; small particles favor kinetics; N/P vs SEI growth direction to be measured. No priority given in task -> all constraints must hold simultaneously.
candidate_strategy: R1: baseline characterization (Chen2020 defaults) + opening ceiling assessment (ceiling_escalation OFF: assess only, do not escalate) - evaluate ED/4C limits under thin collectors/thin separator/optimal porosity/high-transport electrolyte; R2-R7: architecture/formulation variants 2-4 per round (ED group: thicker positive, thinner collectors/separator, lower porosity; kinetics group: smaller particles, higher electrolyte sigma, higher t+; SEI group: thicker negative / higher N-P, larger negative particles; combination group); R8+: DFN re-verification of finalists (auto-degrade to SPMe on solver failure); every round mechanically judged via log-evaluate with fallback routed to the scale of the cause (capacity/temperature -> Stage 3 architecture; material levers disabled by ablation switch).
budget_allocation: baseline+ceiling 1 round (~6 sims); single-factor diagnostics 2 rounds; combined optimization + safety/lowT/aging re-verification 5-7 rounds; DFN re-verification + deliverables 1-2 rounds; total ~10-12 rounds, no hard cap.
risk_and_fallback: ED ceiling risk (baseline measured first; if architecture ceiling < 327.18 -> three-strike questioning -> honest negative result with 'reachable if relaxed to X'); -20C retention>=0.9 is transport/kinetics-harsh (levers: sigma/D formulation, small particles, thin electrodes); SEI 550nm@500c likely tight with SEI kinetics locked (architecture-only mitigation: N/P, particle radius, local current density; SKILL measured signal-scale reference: baseline Chen2020 ~449nm at 100c); 4C safety always with lumped thermal coupling. Known calibers: Chen2020 starts discharged (cathode 27% lithiated) - first-cycle capacity low is known, never compare first cycles; standard SEI capacity trajectory may climb-then-saturate (artifact) - label honestly, rely on sei_thickness_nm_end; update Nominal cell capacity when capacity changes to keep C-rate definitions honest.
